caption: The US government wouldn't admit Area 51 existed… until the CIA did 👽 And its own history says the 'UFOs' people saw were often spy planes. What else is out there? 👇 #area51 #ufo #cia #declassified #conspiracy #history #dailydrop

scenes.title: The base that *didn't exist*
scenes.say: For decades, the US government wouldn't even admit Area 51 existed. Then, in 2013, the CIA did.

scenes.title: Built for *spy planes*
scenes.say: A declassified CIA history confirmed the base in the Nevada desert was built in the 1950s to test a top-secret spy plane. The U-2.

scenes.title: Above *60,000 feet*
scenes.say: The U-2 flew higher than sixty thousand feet, far above the airliners of the time. People who spotted it glinting in the sky reported it as a UFO.

scenes.text: of UFO reports in the late '50s and '60s were *spy-plane flights*
scenes.say: According to the CIA's own history, U-2 and later OXCART flights accounted for more than half of all UFO reports in the late 1950s and most of the 1960s. And the planes stayed secret.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.say: So the secret base? Confirmed. Aliens? In 2024, a Pentagon review found no evidence that any UFO sighting was alien technology.
